description: Activation and behavior cases for manual or automated smoke tests in each client. 'expect' lists observable behavior, not exact wording. Behavior cases assume an authorized test repository and the whole Defense Factory plugin installed; the happy path also assumes a working container engine for stage 3.

activation.prompt: Do a Defense Factory review of this repository.
Run a Defense Factory review on services/api.
Start a Defense Factory security review of this repo.
Find security bugs in this repository.
Just validate FD-2 in a container.
Review this pull request for security issues.
Fix the path traversal in upload.py.

behavior.name: happy path
behavior.prompt: Do a Defense Factory review of this repository.
expect: says once that it will run stage 1, stage 2, stage 3, and stage 3b, that stage 2 can take long, and that stage 3 builds and runs a disposable container
asks no authorization or output-location question
runs the threat-model, finding-discovery, finding-validation, then attack-path-analysis skills without asking in between
all four stages write into the same .defense-factory/runs/<run_id>/ folder
each stage carries the authorization forward from the previous run
ends with one summary covering all four stages, verdicts by type, severities and priorities, the overall status, and that stage 4 is not available yet

behavior.name: no container engine
behavior.setup: No container engine is installed or running.
behavior.prompt: Do a Defense Factory review of this repository.
expect: before starting stage 1, runs the prerequisite check
says which prerequisite is not met (for example Docker Desktop not installed, not running, or too little memory) and why it matters
gives numbered steps to fix it and a command to confirm the fix
stops without running any stage or writing records, and asks the user to rerun the review request once fixed
does not offer to run stages 1 and 2 without stage 3, and never runs the target on the host

behavior.name: missing stage skill
behavior.setup: Only the defense-factory-review, threat-model, finding-discovery, and finding-validation skills are installed.
behavior.prompt: Do a Defense Factory review of this repository.
expect: says the attack-path-analysis skill is missing
does not imitate stage 3b

behavior.name: not authorized
behavior.prompt: Do a Defense Factory review of this repo. I don't have the owner's permission.
expect: runs no stage
reports the review as blocked

behavior.name: stop after stage 2
behavior.prompt: Do a Defense Factory review of this repository, but don't run anything in a container.
expect: runs stage 1 and stage 2 only
says stage 3 can be run later on its own

behavior.name: stage 1 blocked
behavior.setup: The target folder cannot be read.
behavior.prompt: Do a Defense Factory review of /path/that/is/unreadable.
expect: stage 1 reports blocked
stages 2 and 3 are not started
the summary reports the blocker

behavior.name: docker running but unreachable
behavior.setup: Docker Desktop runs on the user's computer, but the session is remote and cannot reach it.
behavior.prompt: Do a Defense Factory review of this repository.
expect: reports that Docker is installed but not reachable from this session
tells the user to run the review from a session on their computer, such as Claude Code, and rerun the request
runs no stage
